session.started: Game started (Seed: {{seed}}). {{side}} setup: Place 6 Influence in {{region}}.
session.positionLoaded: Position loaded from a shared link (undo history starts here).

action.eagleBearLandedPass: {{side}} passes Eagle / Bear Has Landed (Box 6) turn-end discard opportunity.
action.eagleBearLandedDiscard: {{side}} discards {{card}} (#{{id}}) via Eagle / Bear Has Landed (Box 6 privilege).
action.headlineFaceDown: {{side}} commits a Headline Card (face down until both are revealed)
action.grainSalesReturn: {{side}} returns {{card}} (#{{id}}) to the USSR hand and conducts Grain Sales' 2 Ops
action.space: {{side}} attempts Space Race with pending card
action.spaceRoll: {{side}} attempts Space Race with pending card (Input Roll: {{roll}})

choice.starWars: {{side}} takes {{card}} (#{{id}}) from the discard pile and plays its event ({{event}})
choice.salt: {{side}} takes {{card}} (#{{id}}) back into hand from the discard pile ({{event}})
choice.unIntervention: {{side}} plays {{card}} (#{{id}}) with {{event}}: its event is cancelled, {{side}} uses its Ops
choice.grainSalesUn: {{side}} plays {{un}} on the card {{event}} drew: its event is cancelled, {{side}} uses its Ops

headline.revealed: Headlines Simultaneously Revealed: US plays '{{usCard}}' (#{{usId}}, {{usOps}} Ops) vs USSR plays '{{ussrCard}}' (#{{ussrId}}, {{ussrOps}} Ops)

roll.coup: Coup in {{country}}: {{roller}} rolls {{roll}} (+{{mod}} Ops = {{total}}) vs {{defense}} Defense (2x Stability {{stability}}) -> {{result}}
roll.coupWithCard: Coup in {{country}} ({{card}}): {{roller}} rolls {{roll}} (+{{mod}} Ops = {{total}}) vs {{defense}} Defense (2x Stability {{stability}}) -> {{result}}
roll.realign: Realignment in {{country}}: US rolls {{usRoll}} ({{usMod}} mod = {{usTotal}}), USSR rolls {{ussrRoll}} ({{ussrMod}} mod = {{ussrTotal}}) -> {{result}}
roll.warSucceeded: Success ({{total}} >= {{threshold}} target: Target Captured & VP Awarded)
roll.olympics: Olympic Games Competition: Sponsor ({{sponsor}}) rolls {{sponsorRoll}} (+2 = {{sponsorTotal}}), Opponent ({{opponent}}) rolls {{opponentRoll}} -> {{result}}
roll.olympicsTie: Tie (shouldn't happen: a tie is re-rolled)
roll.summit: Summit Rolls: US rolls {{usRoll}} (+{{usMod}} Dom = {{usTotal}}), USSR rolls {{ussrRoll}} (+{{ussrMod}} Dom = {{ussrTotal}}) -> {{result}}

randomDiscardFires: {{side}} discards {{card}} (#{{id}}) at random ({{event}}) — a US event, so its event fires

envy.takesGivers: The {{taker}} takes {{card}} (#{{id}}) from the {{giver}} hand ({{event}}) — a {{giver}} event, so the {{taker}} uses its {{ops}} Ops and the event does not fire
envy.takesBoth: The {{taker}} takes {{card}} (#{{id}}) from the {{giver}} hand ({{event}}) — an event for both sides, so its event fires for the {{taker}}
envy.takesTakers: The {{taker}} takes {{card}} (#{{id}}) from the {{giver}} hand ({{event}}) — a {{taker}} event, so its event fires for the {{taker}}
envy.goes: {{event}} goes to the {{giver}} hand: the {{giver}} must play it for Ops in its next action round

card.nowKnown: {{card}} (#{{id}}) in the {{side}} hand, now known to the {{other}}
card.noLongerKnown: {{card}} (#{{id}}) in the {{side}} hand, no longer known to the {{other}}
card.newEra: {{n}} cards of the new era shuffled into the draw deck
card.reshuffled: The discard pile ({{n}} cards) reshuffled into the draw deck
